key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders positioned for a further RBA rate hike, with the economy 'limping along' (Headlines 35, 74)
Aussie banks forecast the biggest house price falls on record; home loan applications down 15% since budget (Headlines 63, 65)
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle (Headlines 37, 68)
Construction sector under scrutiny: Bathla collapse signals broader 'Ponzi economy' fragility; ratings agencies flag Victoria's soaring debt (Headlines 31, 32, 38)
ASIC launches whistleblower review at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns (Headline 39)
USD tumbles on dovish Waller commentary and yen strength, supportive for AUD and commodity exporters (Headline 62)
Energy transition costs mounting; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns and TMK Energy gas rate surge highlight supply risks (Headlines 70, 72, 67)
EV sales outpace petrol cars for first time in Australia, signalling structural consumer shift (Headline 28)

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces a structural shakeout obscured by war-driven demand; small-caps (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength; Macarthur clears WA bulk test; Aurum adds West African gold ounces
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from iron ore oversupply; small-cap explorers offer speculative upside but carry elevated risk. Gold (AUR.AX) benefits from USD weakness

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks forecast record house price declines; CBA/Westpac face scrutiny over loyalty pricing loopholes; HSBC carries a 'sell' rating
sectors.implications: NIM compression risk as credit growth stalls; CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face earnings headwinds from falling loan volumes and potential NPLs if house prices drop materially

sectors.trend: Energy transition costs 'running off the rails'; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns; TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; cyclone risk from El Niño threatens infrastructure
sectors.implications: SOG.AX, WDS.AX, GWO.AX face policy and supply-chain uncertainty; gas price volatility supports upstream producers but pressures downstream consumers

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse exposes systemic fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower; Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with planned population growth; Victoria debt flagged by ratings agencies
sectors.implications: CGC.AX, WBC.AX (construction exposure), and property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face demand destruction; infrastructure spend may partially offset

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, shifting demand toward tablet GLP-1s; EV adoption accelerates as fuel costs soar; VW cutting 50,000 jobs globally
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX benefit from defensive consumer rotation; EV transition supports charging-infrastructure plays but pressures auto supply chains

sectors.trend: Nvidia signals AI boom continues; skilled migrant priority shifts to AI workers and tradies; AI-powered marketing raising privacy concerns
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) and global AI exposure via ETFs benefit; labour shortage constrains domestic digital transformation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike into a stalling economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (WES.AX, CSL.AX); reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing price correction and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight banks with high residential exposure; monitor NPL trends; favour commercial REITs with long lease tenures
Avoid small-cap construction names; favour large-cap diversified builders with balance-sheet strength

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand shakeout from China
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify mining exposure toward gold (AUR.AX) and critical minerals; monitor BHP.AX, FMG.AX guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overruns and gas supply risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour upstream gas producers with contracted offtake; hedge against policy-driven cost escalation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC governance review at Big Four accountants
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor for spillover into ASX-listed audit clients; no direct ASX exposure but reputational risk to listed entities

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-minerals explorers on USD weakness and small-cap rotation
opportunities.rationale: USD tumble on dovish Waller supports gold; Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals showing relative strength; Aurum adding West African ounces

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive consumer staples and healthcare on rate-hike fears
opportunities.rationale: Economy stalling, political optimism scarce; WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSL.AX offer earnings visibility and dividend support

opportunities.recommendation: Selective upstream gas exposure on supply tightness
opportunities.rationale: TMK Energy gas rate surge, Beetaloo cartel concerns, and El Niño cyclone risk support gas pricing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and bank exposure ahead of record house price falls
defensive_moves.rationale: Banks forecast biggest house price declines on record; 15% loan application drop signals credit contraction; construction follow-through risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge iron ore concentration risk in large-cap miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; China demand uncertainty elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid small-cap construction and property development names
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals systemic fragility; Victoria debt flagged by ratings agencies; housing construction to follow prices lower

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure as RBA rate-hike expectations build against a stalling economy. Housing data (15% loan drop, record price fall forecasts) will weigh on financials and construction. USD weakness provides partial support for materials. Expect volatility around RBA communications.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and housing stabilises. 'Bull case returns' narrative (Headline 40) suggests a potential re-rating if credit contraction is contained. Structural themes – EV transition, AI adoption, critical minerals – support selective outperformance. However, construction fragility and energy transition cost overruns cap upside.
